# Each string input field of the three DSLs whose JSON name is on the audit
# denylist, with why it is not a secret.Value.
# Format: <dsl> <group> <method> <field><TAB>reason. TestSecretsAreTyped fails
# on such a field that is not here: give it the type secret.Value, or add it
# with its reason.
behavior managedfile update content	the whole content of a file, which a caller marks secret: true when it is one; the audit redacts it by name
behavior netplan update content	a netplan config, not a secret; the audit redacts it by name
behavior password update password_hash	the hash that the .Before step sets on the controller; a caller never sends it
behavior user create password_hash	the hash that the .Before step sets on the controller; a caller never sends it
